thread:
maria: FYI - incoming SWIFT (EUR) from 'Global Supplies GmbH' hit our accounts today with NO remittance details. Amount 23,450.00 EUR, acct ending 4321. Can't map to any open invoice. bank trace: TRN-7865421. Ticket #INC-2026-882 created.
jason: :eyes: can you paste the MT103 or the ordering bank ref? Is this a customer payment to us or an outbound?
maria: inbound to us (customer payment). Statement line only shows sender name, no invoice/PO. No MT103 attached in the feed.
liam: quick check — run a candidate search by amount+date. ```sql
SELECT invoice_id, po_number, customer_name, due_date FROM invoices
WHERE total_due = 23450.00 AND currency = 'EUR' AND status IN ('open','partially_paid');
``` I see INV-2026-114 matches amount but customer name is different (BetaApps) and PO differs.
anya: billing note — INV-2026-114 belongs to BetaApps, not Global Supplies. :thinking_face:
maria: attaching bank snippet: ```text
2026-02-15 | OUTGOING | TRN-7865421 | Global Supplies GmbH | 23450.00 EUR
``` no beneficiary reference or invoice number.
jason: Ops/treasury: please request MT103 from our correspondent bank right away — that should reveal the ordering bank remittance/message field. If bank can't, we'll ask payer for confirmation.
liam: I'll try a fuzzy-match routine (beneficiary IBAN + amount + value date). If confidence > 0.92 we can auto-apply; otherwise surface candidates. Prototype query below (pseudo): ```sql
-- find candidates by amount/date/iban similarity
SELECT invoice_id, similarity_score FROM candidate_matches WHERE amount = 23450.00 AND value_date = '2026-02-15' ORDER BY similarity_score DESC LIMIT 5;
```
maria: customer support says payer claims they referenced PO-3321 when they paid. PO-3321 is tied to INV-2026-099 in our ledger — different amount. Could be wrong PO on payment.
jason: Ok plan: 1) liam run the fuzzy candidate job and post results here; 2) maria open a request with bank for MT103 and escalate FIN-5698; 3) billing hold any auto-allocation for that amount until we confirm. I'll loop in finance lead. :+1:
billingbot: Automated alert — HOLD allocation for amount 23450.00 EUR until reconciliation complete. New ticket FIN-5698 created.
anya: If MT103 is unavailable from our bank, we'll need the payer to provide wire confirmation (showing ordering bank reference / remittance) and a copy of the invoice/PO they intended to pay. Use template: "Please share MT103 or payment confirmation showing ordering bank and remittance details."
maria: Also filing an internal suggestion: add a Console fallback that when remit is missing we show top-3 fuzzy matches (amount+date+iban) to finance users for one-click allocation — reduces manual work. I'll file product suggestion in Optimize backlog.
jason: Great. tagging: @liam @anya @maria @billingbot. Leaving this thread open until FIN-5698 resolved and MT103 or payer confirmation available.
